articles.title: How AI Is Changing What Companies Know About Their Customers
articles.summary: Fifteen years ago, when he worked as an adviser to the pharmaceutical industry, Jeff Gaus’ firm bought drugstore cash-register data. From those records, he says, the company could tell pharma reps that, for example, “Dr. Smith has three people with this condition” and instruct them to go pitch their wares to that doctor. articles.title: Trump Gives ‘America’s Mayor’ the Presidential Medal of Freedom
articles.summary: President Donald Trump on Tuesday presented Rudy Giuliani, the former Mayor of New York City who served as Trump’s personal lawyer in 2020, with the Presidential Medal of Freedom. Appearing on Steve Bannon’s War Room podcast on Monday, Giuliani said that he was “very, very humbled and very honored” by the recognition. Giuliani rose to prominence as a prosecutor in New York and was first elected Mayor of New York City in 1993 as a Republican. articles.title: Habits Food-Waste Experts Recommend This Thanksgiving
articles.summary: For millions around the country, Thanksgiving preparations are in full swing. But after we fill up on turkey and countless sides, what’s left often goes to waste. One study found that, in 2025, Americans discarded enough food to fill 40 football fields from their Thanksgiving meals. We spoke with experts about how you can avoid food waste this Thanksgiving. articles.title: Hegseth’s Pentagon Accuses Canada of Failing as Credible Defense Partner Amid Tensions
articles.summary: The Pentagon has accused Canada of falling short as a credible partner in defending North America, escalating tensions between the neighboring countries amid an ongoing trade war . In a two-page fact sheet released Monday, the Pentagon under Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth outlined what it described as Canada's “defense shortfalls,” issuing a sharp rebuke of the country's leadership under Prime Minister Mark Carney .
